status_definitions.functional: Exercised workflow worked, without implying complete feature coverage.
status_definitions.partial: Some workflow observed; stated limits remain.
status_definitions.dependency: A configured dependency of exercised consumers; not independently verified.
status_definitions.blocked: A required prerequisite prevented the workflow.
status_definitions.anomaly: Observed mismatch or failure with stated scope.
status_definitions.unverified: No individual functional behavior was established.
